पैशाच a. (-ची f.)
 [पिशाचेन निर्वृत्तः अण्] Demoniacal, infernal.

पैशाच + .{@-चः@}
—1 The eighth or lowest of the eight forms
[]
 of marriage in Hindu law, in which a lover ravishes a maiden without her
 consent when she is sleeping, or intoxicated, or deranged in intellect;
 सुप्तां मत्तां प्रमत्तां वा रहो यत्रोपगच्छति । स पापिष्ठो विवाहानां
 पैशाचश्चाष्टमो ऽधमः Ms. 3. 34; Y. 1. 61.
—2 A kind of demon or पिशाच.

पैशाच + .{@-ची@}
—1 A present made at a religious ceremony.
—2 Night.
—3 A sort of gibberish spoken on the stage by demons.
—4 One of the forms of Prākṛta.

पैशुनम्, -न्यम्
 [पिशुनस्य भावः अण् ष्यञ् वा]
—1 Backbiting, slandering, tale-bearing, calumny; पैशुन्यं साहसं … … क्रोधजोऽपि
 गणोऽष्टकः Ms. 7. 48, 11. 56; Bg. 16. 2.
—2 Roguery, depravity.
—3 Wickdness, malignity.

पैष्ट a. (-ष्टी f.)
 [पिष्टस्येदम् अण्] Made of flour or meal.

पैष्टिक a. (-की f.)
 Made of flour or meal.

पैष्टी A spirituous liquor distilled from meal; cf. गौडी; गौडी पैष्टी
 च माध्वी च विज्ञेया त्रिविधा सुरा Ms. 11. 94.
